final_answer_text:
Here is what your chart points to for remedial work right now — and one thing I have to be honest with you about first.

**The remedy the chart actually asks for: Venus.**
Your remedy layer ranks **Venus as the #1 target, priority class "critical."** Venus is also the weakest graha in your chart by strength (Ṣaḍbala 0.84, the lowest of the nine), and in the Navāṃśa — the varga governing marriage and dharma — **Venus is debilitated.** So Venus is weak in the birth chart, weak again in the varga where it matters most, and top-ranked for remediation. That convergence is real.

The timing supports it too, and specifically now:
- Your current solar year (Feb 2026 – Feb 2027) has **Venus as the year-lord**, with the **Muntha in Libra — your 7th house — whose lord is also Venus.** Venus is the presiding graha of this year of your life. A Venus remedy undertaken now is working with the year's own current, not against it.

**The practice, in order of classical weight:**
1. **Śukra bīja mantra** — *Oṃ Drāṃ Drīṃ Drauṃ Saḥ Śukrāya Namaḥ* — 108 times each Friday morning, facing east. (BPHS Ch. 91–94; classical strength 0.90.) This is the simple, low-cost, high-feasibility core.
2. **Śukra Aṣṭottara Śatanāmāvalī** — the 108 names of Venus — also on Fridays. (BPHS Ch. 88.)
3. If you want a third: **Śrī Sūkta**, the sixteen verses from the Ṛgveda Khilāni, on Fridays. (Strength 0.88.)

All three are simple, require no acharya supervision, and cost nothing.

**A second thread worth knowing.** Saturn is currently transiting Pisces, which is the **2nd house from your natal Moon in Aquarius** — the **third and final phase of Sāḍe Sātī.** That is the closing stretch of a seven-and-a-half year Saturn passage. The classical remedy for this phase is Saturn-directed: the Śani bīja mantra on Saturdays, or the Śani Aṣṭottara. Your remedy engine ranks Saturn *last* of nine for intrinsic weakness, so I would treat this as situational rather than structural — a transit you are finishing, not a chart defect you carry.

**Now the thing I must not hide from you.**
When I asked the system specifically what remedy would repair your **relationship** prospects, it returned a verdict I did not expect and that sits badly against what I told you earlier. Its promise-chain diagnosis came back **`denied_at_promise`**: *"the rāśi checklist does not promise this matter — hostile occupants and aspects and a weak, poorly-disposed house-lord outweigh the supportive factors. Per the classical chain, no later stage can deliver what the rāśi itself does not promise."* That verdict is backed by 63 chart facts and graded strong.

This **directly contradicts** the confident late-2027 marriage window I gave you from the forecasting tool. And I now know why: that forecasting tool **states in its own output that promise-gating is not yet applied to its windows** — it reports when the 7th house is *activated*, without ever checking whether the chart *promises* delivery. Activation without promise is, in the classical idiom, pressure without result.

I am not going to resolve that contradiction for you, because I do not think it is mine to resolve — one half of the system says the matter is promised and timed, the other says it is not promised at all, and there is no adjudication between them. **What I will do is retract the confidence of my earlier answer.** Treat the 2027–2030 relationship window as *possible activation*, not as a promised marriage.

**And a caution about remedies generally.** Two things I checked and want you to know: the remedy engine has recorded **zero outcomes ever** — it reports that honestly and refuses to quote you a success rate, which I respect. And its ranking, once I looked at the numbers, is essentially an inverse-strength ordering with three of its four inputs sitting at constant values for every graha. So "Venus, critical" is a well-grounded *identification of your weakest graha*. It is not a validated prescription. Do the Friday practice because it is classically sound, cheap, and harmless — not because a number said 0.173.
